source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះក្រូចពោធិ៍សាត់ដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ / Climate Resilient Orange Growing Technique", Nov 2018, 23pp
text:
Regular weeding (ការសម្អាតស្មៅ) keeps grass and weeds from competing with young and mature trees for water and nutrients; farmers are advised to cut grass on a regular schedule rather than letting it grow tall between cuts.

Good land and soil-fertility management (ការគ្រប់គ្រងជីជាតិដី) also includes periodic pruning to maintain an open canopy and good growth habit, appropriate tree spacing to allow airflow and light penetration, and removing diseased or damaged branches promptly so problems do not spread through the orchard.
